# Sasaki

> > Sasaki is a leading architecture and design firm specializing in integrated design solutions with expertise in BIM, digital practice, and sustainable built environments.

Sasaki brings together architects, landscape architects, planners, and designers to create transformative spaces. The firm emphasizes digital innovation through Building Information Modeling (BIM) and advanced project management methodologies.

## Key Topics

- BIM (Building Information Modeling)
- Digital Practice Leadership
- Architecture
- Project Management
- Construction Administration
- Integrated Design
- Sustainable Design
- Urban Planning
- Landscape Architecture

- [Luis Cetrangolo](https://www.sasaki.com/people/luis-cetrangolo): Profile of Luis Cetrangolo, Architect and BIM Director at Sasaki
